entities.name: Chucrallah-Nabil El-Hage

entities.summary: Chucrallah-Nabil El-Hage, also transliterated Shukrallah Nabil El Hajj, was the Archeparch of the Maronite Catholic Archeparchy of Tyre from 2003 until his retirement in 2020.
